_comment: PHASE 9 recovery item 14B. Individual audit of the 27 phantom node ids that item 14A could not classify. This is an AUDIT: no production changed, no alias created, no node implemented. Every classification records the evidence it rests on, and 'a node with a similar name exists' was explicitly rejected as evidence -- where that is all there is, the id stays H_UNKNOWN. H is a valid result: inventing semantics would be worse than admitting ignorance. PHASE 9 recovery item 14E reauthored BossAILogic.zlogic and EnemyAILogic.zlogic onto the canonical scalar chase chain proven in item 14D.2, which removed every instance of math.distance, vector2 and normalize_vector. Those three ids left this file because a recovered id must leave the baseline -- this is debt, not exemption. Entries unrelated to the two AI graphs are untouched. PHASE 9 recovery item 16C added math.divide -> divide_number and ui.set_progress_bar -> set_ui_progress_bar to the legacy migration map, so both ids stopped being phantom. A recovered id leaves the record.
_provenance: PHASE 9 recovery item 14E, regenerated after reauthoring the two AI graphs. | Item 17 recovered animator.set_trigger. | Item 18 authored PlayerHealthLogic off event.custom-as-emitter.
